text:
sarah_oncall: quick handoff — i'm wrapping up the evening shift, leaving a live mitigation and a few follow-ups for night. TL;DR: embeddings autoscaler oscillation caused degraded embed throughput for ~35m, customers saw increased embedding latency and a few 503s. we've stabilized by pinning a smaller replica set and enabling emergency throttle; primary/secondary swapped for eu-west. full notes below.

maya_sre: thanks — appreciate the summary. can you list who is primary/secondary and any coverage gaps?

sarah_oncall: primary=maya_sre (night), secondary=neil_prodeng (backup). i'm handing off as observer for first 30m in case anything escalates. coverage gap: no dedicated oncall in ap-south overnight — routing policy currently allows eu fallback but if eu saturates, ap customers may see queued requests. ops-runbook points to cross-region failover steps.

neil_prodeng: noted. what's the current impact window and user-facing status?

sarah_oncall: impact window ~21:12–21:47 UTC. User-facing: increased latency up to 8-12s for embeddings, rate of 503s peaked at 0.4% of embedding requests. most traffic recovered after autoscaler pin and manual eviction of noisy jobs. No broad data loss.

ops-bot: INCIDENT LOG — incident #INC-2026-867 created at 1829994321. Severity: Sev2. Pager entries: 3. Linked runbook: <https://redwood-infra.internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler|embeddings-autoscaler>.

maya_sre: ok good. What mitigation steps did you take and commands so we can repeat if it flares?

sarah_oncall: sequence —
- checked metrics in <https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/embeds|embeds dashboard> (high pod churn + sustained queue).
- scaled down noisy model pool: `kubectl scale deploy/model-embeds-pool --replicas=6 -n prod`
- pinned autoscaler config to min=4,max=8 for the affected pool (temp change) — config id `autocfg-2026-03-14-pin`
- evicted three long-running batch jobs via internal job-killer: `python tools/kill_job.py --job-id 98321,98322,98323`
- enabled emergency request-throttle for embeddings route: `redwoodctl throttle set /v1/embeddings rps=250`

maya_sre: can you paste the exact autoscaler patch?

sarah_oncall: sure, patched with:
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: embed-pool-hpa
spec:
  minReplicas: 4
  maxReplicas: 8
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 75
```

tara_support: customer note: Support queue showed ~12 tickets referencing slow embeddings, caller reported app timeouts. I left a short status update on the affected tickets pointing to the incident. No escalations to sales yet.

neil_prodeng: thanks. any logs or traces to look at on first wake?

sarah_oncall: main things to check:
- grafana panel `embed_p95` and `embed_503_rate` (time range 21:00–22:00 UTC)
- logs: `k8s/model-embeds-pool` in prod, filter for `batch-job` and `evict`
- tracer: `trace/service=embed-service name=CreateEmbedding` sampling shows increased latency traces around 21:15

neil_prodeng: are there any automated rollback thresholds set we should be aware of?

sarah_oncall: yes — if 503 rate > 1% for 10m we autotrigger fallback to `embeds-lowcost-v2` and send an alert to primary. I left the fallback disabled during manual mitigation but it's in config; policy id `route-policy-embed-fallback-2`.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty — created alert PD-82421 for embedding-route-503 spike, assigned to maya_sre.

maya_sre: going to take primary now. i'll keep autoscaler pinned to min=4 for the next 45m and monitor p95. neil, you'll be secondary?

neil_prodeng: yep. i'll standby and keep an eye on eu region capacity. If we see >50% saturation on eu, i'll open the cross-region spill and notify support.

maya_sre: action items for night:
- monitor embed p95 and 503 rate for first hour, escalate if >0.8% for 5m.
- if embedding queue length grows >500, trigger manual spill to `embeds-lowcost-v2` and notify oncall.
- for sustained churn, follow runbook step 3b (drain noisy model nodes) — link: <https://redwood-infra.internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler#3b|3b>.

sarah_oncall: i uploaded the diagnostics bundle: <https://artifacts.redwood/internal/inc-INC-2026-867/diag.tar.gz|diag.tar.gz> includes heap/stack dumps and job lists. also pinned the temporary config in consul under `prod/embed/auto_pin=2026-03-14`.

maya_sre: perfect. handoff checklist —
- primary/secondary confirmed (maya/neil) :white_check_mark:
- incident doc started in ops-notes (link above) :white_check_mark:
- runbook and rollback rules noted :white_check_mark:
- ap-south coverage gap logged in triage board (<https://boards.redwood/internal/triage|triage>) :point_up:

tara_support: i've scheduled a short customer update at 23:00 UTC for affected tenants. Will post template in the support channel if you need to grab it.

neil_prodeng: small note — if you need to re-enable fallback, command is `redwoodctl route set /v1/embeddings fallback=embeds-lowcost-v2 --force` (requires 2 approvals).

maya_sre: good to know. ok i'm taking the pager. sarah, thanks for the thorough handoff. i'll ping if anything changes.

sarah_oncall: thanks all — leaving bridge pinned in case of escalations. closing my shift now. :wave:

ops-bot: SHIFT HANDOFF — user sarah_oncall marked `handed_off` to maya_sre at 1829996225.

maya_sre: night team — ping me on slack or pager if you see embedding regressions. I'll update this thread with any developments.

neil_prodeng: acknowledged. I'll jump in if any regional spill decisions are needed.

tara_support: noted, will keep support updates synced.

sarah_oncall: end.
